VST3 generated C API
=====================

Source: https://github.com/steinbergmedia/vst3_c_api
Tag: v3.8.1_build_84
Commit: 93a116f7c6c52a317ec3aaee9b13789068b5234e
File: vst3_c_api.h

SDK context:
  vst3sdk tag v3.8.1_build_84
  root commit 3cdf9ca5d1f5b1b21e0a86832aa4abe55607bd96

The header is generated upstream and is vendored unchanged. Production code
binds only the interfaces used by the reviewed VST3 gates. The generated API
license text is retained in LICENSE.txt. Its README's dual-license wording
conflicts with the tagged license text; this discrepancy remains documented
for redistribution review.
